column1: # Placeholders deliberately deferred, and the command that removes each one.
# THIS FILE IS THE ESCAPE HATCH, NOT THE OFF SWITCH. It exists so one specific
# placeholder can wait without anybody having to disable
# scripts/placeholder-check.sh -- which is how a check stops existing.
# Format, TAB-separated, three columns, all required:
# The glob is a shell `case` pattern, so `*` spans directory separators.
# The reason must name the command or runbook that deletes the line. An entry
# whose placeholder is already gone is reported as stale on every run.
# Columns are TABS. A space-separated line is rejected, on purpose: a silently
# misparsed allowlist is worse than no allowlist.
